# cutbg (Remove Background)
> Local-first open-source background remover for humans and AI agents. Runs RMBG-1.4 in the browser. No photo upload to the site. No clone required.

Images stay on the device. The model downloads from Hugging Face once.

## Agent how-to (HTTP + web)

1. GET https://cutbg.vercel.app/api/capabilities?via=agent
2. Read https://cutbg.vercel.app/llms.txt and the skill it links
3. Open a deep link (CORS must allow the image URL). Always include via=agent for analytics:

```
https://cutbg.vercel.app/?src=<encoded-image-url>&via=agent&crop=auto&advanced=1
https://cutbg.vercel.app/?src=<encoded-image-url>&via=agent&color=%23e85d04&crop=auto
```

Human guide: https://cutbg.vercel.app/for-agents
Skill: https://cutbg.vercel.app/agent-skills/remove-background/SKILL.md
Catalog: https://cutbg.vercel.app/agents.json

Query params: `src` / `url` / `image`, `via=agent`, `color` / `fill`, `crop=auto` or `x,y,w,h`, `advanced=1`.

Analytics (Vercel custom events, no images): `cutout_start` (client=human|agent), `tool_color`, `tool_crop`, `tool_advanced`, `agent_discover`.

## Web
- App: https://cutbg.vercel.app/
- For agents: https://cutbg.vercel.app/for-agents
- Capabilities API: https://cutbg.vercel.app/api/capabilities?via=agent
